client_equivalence: Steam and STOVE share screen contracts; every action still requires current recognition.

heroes.acquisition: Only obtain a hero when required by the current mission or an explicit recorded selection.
heroes.selection: Current owned roster and selected hero must prove the target; static IDs do not prove ownership.

checkpoint.level_target: Minimum level needed by the next group; already met targets require no spending.
checkpoint.awakening_target: Minimum current/next-group requirement on the selected owned hero; do not repeat an already observed upgrade.
checkpoint.equipment: Review the carry after every group; apply only identified equipment with observed comparison and a verified final slot.
checkpoint.skills: Prefer skill improvements that satisfy the current group's event count; do not spend future event counts early.
checkpoint.promotion: Only when a current or next-group level/grade requirement needs it and cost/target are observed.

milestone.when: Inspect after each completed group; eligibility depends on current unlock, essence and price, not a fixed Path level.
milestone.shop_priority: Observed Epic equipment useful to the selected carry; exact item, price, currency and stock must be verified.
milestone.selector: A selector requires a named choice recorded by the agent; never infer a choice from its presentation.
milestone.static_drop_note: These are package candidates; they do not prove current balance, eligibility or a measured gain.
